lines.text: Moses gathered the congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and washed Aaron and his sons with water.
Moses clothed Aaron, put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece, and set a gold plate on the turban.
Moses anointed the tabernacle and sprinkled oil on the altar twelve times, then poured oil on Aaron's head.
Moses slaughtered the sin offering bull, put its blood on the altar's horns, and burned its hide at Shiloh.
Aaron and his sons were told to stay at the entrance seven days, and they did everything commanded.
